caption: A light curtain hanging in front of an open window billows into the room with each gust of wind and falls back between gusts.

sa.check: A light curtain hangs in front of an open window.
The billowing repeats with each gust.
Each billow comes first and the fall back follows.

pc.expect: The curtain moves in step with the wind, inward with a gust and back when it drops.
pc.fail: It moves with the window shut and no wind signs; or it billows outward through the window against the gust; or it stays rigidly still while other things blow.

pc.expect: The light fabric flows and ripples and hangs in folds when slack.
pc.fail: It is rigid like a board; or stretches like elastic; or stays inflated after the gust.

pc.expect: Between gusts it hangs down from the rail.
pc.fail: It hangs sideways with no wind; or rises to the ceiling; or floats.

pc.expect: The billow is into the room, downwind of the window.
pc.fail: It billows outward with the same wind; or alternates directions with no cause; or swings crosswise.

pc.expect: One curtain on one rail keeps its number.
pc.fail: The curtain duplicates; or passes through the wall; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The curtain's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The curtain changes colour; or the window changes; or the room rearranges.
